description: A seeded airborne rotating radar example with retained platform telemetry, per-cell coordinate compensation and detection-only tracking. Relative power is not calibrated watts.

synthesis.targetModel: Ground A: E=950+8t,N=1700-3t; ground B: E=-1900+4t,N=2300+2t; stationary landmark:E=2600,N=-500. Metres and seconds.
synthesis.beam: Gaussian power response sigma=2.1 degrees, FWHM=4.945122 degrees; range response sigma=70 m. Antenna azimuth is clockwise from platform heading. Geometry evaluated at dwell midpoint.
synthesis.noise: Exponential power mean0.055 + floor0.025. World-anchored broad clutter peak0.48, angular sigma16 degrees and range sigma450m, uniform[0.8,1.2] texture. Clutter center E100,N850. No terrain, propagation or elevation-beam model.
synthesis.attenuation: Target A gain4.2 becomes0.015 in scans6–8; target B gain3.6(airborne)/3.4(shipborne) becomes0.015 in scans11–12. Stationary landmark gain2.8/2.7. Prescribed fading, no physical obstruction solution.
synthesis.transient: One additional gain2.4 point component during scan4, at E-2600,N-1500, treated as any other return by the detector/tracker.
synthesis.truth: Separate scenario-truth.csv gives positions at every dwell end. Generator truth labels are not supplied to detection or tracking.

detector.training: Same azimuth; range offsets -10..-3 and 3..10, clipped at array boundaries. No angular training. This empirical threshold is not a calibrated constant-false-alarm-rate claim.
detector.peaks: Power >= retained float32 threshold and greatest power in a 3 × 3 azimuth/range neighborhood; azimuth wraps. Equal-valued ties choose lower storage index. First/last range bins are excluded.
detector.localization: Center of positive power over the retained 3x3 neighborhood after subtracting0.08. Project each cell using its own dwell-midpoint position and heading; omit impossible slant-to-plane cells. Then average in common east/north coordinates. Peak-cell timestamp remains the detection epoch. Ownship motion is compensated; moving targets are not deskewed to a common epoch.
detector.timing: time_s is selected dwell midpoint. Outputs become available only at the end of the complete scan, because peak/centroid calculations use neighboring azimuth dwells.

tracker.measurement: Common east/north detections only. Independent assumed sigma=75m errors. Navigation and projection parameters are treated as exact, not propagated.
tracker.transition: Constant velocity. F=[[1,0,dt,0],[0,1,0,dt],[0,0,1,0],[0,0,0,1]]. Q=sigma_a² G Gᵀ, G=[[dt²/2,0],[0,dt²/2],[dt,0],[0,dt]], sigma_a = 1.5 m/s²; each propagation interval has independent assumed acceleration.
tracker.association: Detections processed by measurement time within a completed scan. Greedy minimum squared innovation Mahalanobis distance <= 9.21034. At most one detection per track per scan. Unassigned detections start new tracks; no scene identities or truth labels supplied.
tracker.initialization: Position from detection; zero initial velocity; covariance diag(5625,5625,900,900).
tracker.update: Linear Kalman update with Joseph covariance form. Export all active states at scan end. Confirmed after 3 total updates; any missed update gives coasting; retire after 4 consecutive misses. Confirmed is a filter bookkeeping state, not identification or verification.
tracker.uncertainty: 95% Gaussian position ellipse conditional on the declared exact platform pose and projection plane. Assumed filter errors are not empirically calibrated.
tracker.fullCovariance: track-state.csv stores all 4 × 4 entries p00..p33 and hit/miss counters. Position-only covariance is in tracks.csv.

timing.meaning: Authored UTC origin plus retained relative seconds; no physical clock, synchronization or cross-capture alignment is claimed.
timing.batchAvailability: Detections and tracks appear after the completed scan; returns become available after each dwell.

exclusions: No terrain masking, multipath or atmosphere
No target identity or real-world capability claim
No navigation, heading, altitude or projection-plane uncertainty propagation
No pitch, roll, heave or antenna lever-arm solution
No compensation for target motion within the detection neighborhood

platform.model: Constant-speed, constant-turn level yaw path; see retained platform-pose.csv and executable model.
platform.sampling: One exact authored pose at every dwell midpoint, keyed by scan and azimuth indices.
platform.attitude: Level yaw only. Pitch, roll, heave, antenna mounting offsets and navigation errors are not modeled.
platform.projection: Slant range projected onto the declared plane up=0, with each dwell platform up=900 m. Every modeled scattering component is assumed on that plane; elevation response is not modeled. Cells with slant range below platform height are unprojectable.
